high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from the Fortune website, specifically from an article about the Fortune COO Summit. The top of the page features the Fortune logo and a banner celebrating 190 years of the company. There is also a "Subscribe Now" button and a "Sign In" option on the right side. The main content of the image is a recommended video from the Fortune COO Summit. The video shows three individuals seated on a stage with a colorful, abstract background. The backdrop includes the Fortune COO Summit logo prominently displayed.
